title: Name That Beat
summary: On a rooftop in the Glen at dusk, V tunes a radio and Viktor guesses the decade and genre of each song before the title shows.
description: Viktor invites V to a rooftop in the Glen at dusk, with a portable radio and an opinion about music. He guesses the decade and genre of each song before the title shows.
